title: Proxy-object adapter shared capture budget fast slice
mode: Local adapter implementation with generated focused validation
head: de27a3391a624aba03ca71f3583c4b3a6e6396a9
scope: Bound both typed DRW_ProxyObject and raw ACAD_PROXY_OBJECT adapter copies.
Charge both callback forms to one aggregate budget.
Verify typed-first and raw-first rejection fail closed before output publication.

changes.implementation: The typed callback estimates common table-entry/XDATA content, proxy subclass, three binary payload vectors, object-ID reference slots, and two logical list-link slots. The raw callback estimates the raw carrier plus two list-link slots. Both charge one dx_data counter, with a 100,000-record ceiling per vector and DRW::kMaxDxfBinaryPayloadBytes aggregate logical bytes. Any rejection/allocation failure sets a sticky flag checked by fileExport.
changes.generatedTest: The selector verifies typed and raw retention and shared charge, then tests an over-budget typed first callback and an over-budget raw first callback in separate empty dx_data objects; neither is appended and neither can publish a DXF. No drawing fixture is used.
changes.limits: Logical retained payload/container slots and list links are estimated, not implementation-specific allocator metadata or process RSS.

nonClaims: No arbitrary proxy-data fidelity or modeler/ACIS semantic support claim is established.
J256, J260, J268, J284, J293, and J295 remain DEFERRED_EXTERNAL and non-promoting.
No external drawings or repository fixtures were added.
The shared worktree is extensively dirty; no staging or commit occurred.
